notes.body:
Mathematical model of yeast osmostat, Talemi et al. 2016. The model is the result of an interdisciplinary project "Systems Biology Analysis of the Yeast Osmostat". The project was conducted by the following researchers:
Soheil Rastgou Talemi, Carl-Fredrik Tiger, Mikael Andersson, Roja Babazadeh, Niek Welkenhuysen, Edda Klipp, Stefan Hohmann, Jörg Schaber.
